title: KEEP LEARNING
hookText: Your mind ages the day you stop learning
openLoop: Coming up: why the greatest minds never graduated

teasers.text: Still ahead: you can't cut tomorrow's tree with today's blade

recap.title: Keep Learning
items: Vitality is measured by curiosity, not biology
You cannot take a holiday from feeding your mind
A wise man keeps hearing and increasing learning
What got you here won't keep you here

scenes.point: Stay curious and your mind refuses to retire
